observations: Photo 0 shows two transmission bellhousing/gearbox assemblies laid out together, with wiring/hoses and a starter area visible; no clear Toyota model/gearbox code readable.
Photo 1 shows the underside/side of a gearbox with multiple connectors/wiring harnesses; no readable part number or gearbox type label.
Photo 2 shows a complete gearbox assembly on the floor with hoses/wiring and mounting points; again no readable model/type/gear count.

claims.claim: automatic gearbox and manual gearbox for toyota corolla, carry, hillux,...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not show a clear Toyota model/Corolla/Hilux/Cary identification or whether the unit is automatic vs manual.

risks.risk: Automatic vs manual is not confirmed from the photos; wrong type would make the purchase unusable.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox label/ID plate or transmission code (and/or the selector/TCU connector area) showing whether it is AT or MT.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed type (worst case: treat as not matching your intended Toyota gearbox).

risks.risk: Toyota model/engine compatibility (Corolla vs Hilux vs Carry) is not confirmed; wrong bellhousing/gear ratios/ECU interface can prevent fitment.
risks.proof: Photo of the transmission code/part number stamped on the casing + photo of the bellhousing side that matches the engine pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown compatibility (worst case: assume it may not fit your exact vehicle).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown; photos show a dismantled unit but do not prove it shifts or drives.
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (bench test or installed test) showing gear engagement and no abnormal noises/leaks.

risks.risk: Missing parts risk (sensors, harness connectors, torque converter/solenoids, cooler lines, mounting brackets) cannot be verified.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo of all included components + close-ups of connector ends and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts may be missing.

risks.risk: Leakage/damage risk (cracks, stripped mounts, damaged housings) is not fully visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the casing seams, mounting ears, and any wet/oily areas; plus underside inspection shots.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the gearbox ID plate/label or stamped transmission code (for AT/MT confirmation).
Send a photo showing the bellhousing/engine mounting side that matches Corolla/Hilux/Carry (compatibility proof).
Send a short video of the gearbox test (or installed test) showing it engages gears and runs without leaks/noise.
Send a photo of everything included (sensors/solenoids/harness/hoses/mounting brackets) laid out, and confirm what is missing.
response.reason: The photos show a gearbox assembly but do not provide readable identification (Toyota model/AT vs MT/part number) and do not prove working condition. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be reliably matched to the correct comparable listings.
